source: Tan, Tamisha & Kühlert (2020), in the Proceedings of the Workshop on Turkic and Languages in Contact with Turkic 5. 140–154.
notes: We argue that the impersonal passive was reanalyzed as a passive. The bridging context for this shift is as follows: due to Sakha being a pro-drop language, a passive impersonal in the earlier language could have easily been mistaken for a personal passive with a silent 3SG subject.
